en_title: Ahead of Metro 2039, Metro 2033 and Metro Last Light Are Getting Next-Gen Updates
subtitle: 老兵再战次世代
opus_summary: 4A Games宣布，《地铁2033》和《地铁：最后的曙光》将于10月22日登陆PC、10月29日登陆主机并获得次世代更新。更新将加入主机高帧率模式及PC版DLSS支持，完整说明将在发售前公布。

paragraphs.en: Metro 2039 is not terribly far away now, launching on February 4, 2027. While that game will truly bring the franchise to current generation consoles, developer 4A Games is launching next-gen updates for the first two games.
paragraphs.cn: 《地铁2039》距离发售已经不远，将于2027年2月4日推出。虽然这款游戏才会真正把该系列带上本世代主机，但开发商4A Games将为前两部作品推出次世代更新。

paragraphs.en: Both Metro 2033 and Metro Last Light were incredible tech showcases for their time, but they haven't exactly aged gracefully. Despite getting an intial remaster all the way back in 2014, Metro 2033 doesn't play super well with modern hardware, and I've needed to tweak it every time I've gone back to play it. Luckily, these next-gen updates should bring some long-needed bug fixes to the game.
paragraphs.cn: 《地铁2033》和《地铁：最后的曙光》在当年都是展现技术实力的佳作，但它们如今的表现并不算理想。尽管《地铁2033》早在2014年就推出过一次重制版，但它与现代硬件的兼容性并不出色。我每次重玩时，都得对游戏进行调整。好在，这次次世代更新应该会为游戏带来一些早就需要的错误修复。

paragraphs.en: The update will look different on console and on PC. For PS5 and Xbox Series X , the Metro games will run at either native 4K at 60 fps or an upscaled 4K at 120 fps, with PSSR on PS5 Pro and traditional temporal upscaling on the Xbox consoles. Over on PC, though, the game will finally have DLSS support, along with some unnamed quality-of-life improvements.
paragraphs.cn: 主机版和PC版的更新内容会有所不同。在PS5和XBOX Series X上，《地铁》系列游戏将提供原生4K、60帧模式，或升频4K、120帧模式；PS5 Pro还将支持PSSR，XBOX主机则采用传统的时间性升频技术。至于PC版，游戏终于会支持DLSS，同时还会加入一些尚未公布的便利性改进。

paragraphs.en: 4A Games hasn't shared a lot of details on the updates coming to Metro 2033 and Metro Last Light, but it does promise to share full patch notes ahead of its October 22 release on PC and October 29 release on consoles. Either way, as long as the games are more stable, I'm all in.
paragraphs.cn: 4A Games尚未透露《地铁2033》和《地铁：最后的曙光》更新的太多细节，但承诺会在PC版10月22日、主机版10月29日推出前公布完整补丁说明。无论如何，只要游戏能变得更加稳定，我就十分期待。

paragraphs.en: As a lifelong PC gamer, all three of the Metro games hold a special place in my heart, for all the torture they've put my graphics cards through in the past. Luckily, if you don't like putting your hardware through the wringer, it doesn't sound like 4A is going to add ray tracing or anything crazy to 2033 or Last Light, so they should be significantly easier to run at high settings than they were when they launched in 2010 and 2013.
paragraphs.cn: 作为一名从小玩PC游戏的玩家，《地铁》系列三部作品在我心中都有着特殊的位置，毕竟它们过去让我的显卡饱受折磨。好在，如果你不想让硬件承受这种考验，那么从目前的说法来看，4A似乎不会为《地铁2033》或《地铁：最后的曙光》加入光线追踪之类的夸张功能。因此，与它们分别于2010年和2013年推出时相比，两款游戏应该会更容易以高画质运行。

paragraphs.en: We've already gone hands-on with Metro 2039 , and it seems like an incredible and brutal post-apocalyptic shooter — just like I'd want out of the franchise. The visuals we've seen so far look incredible too, so I can only imagine that it's going to stay true to its roots of pushing PC hardware to its limits. Although, it is launching in the middle of an ongoing RAM crisis, which is going to limit its already niche appeal a bit when the benchmarks start rolling out. Here's to hoping 4A Games finds a way to make a Metro game scalable at launch for once.
paragraphs.cn: 我们已经亲自体验过《地铁2039》，它似乎是一款惊艳而残酷的末日后射击游戏，正是我希望这个系列呈现的样子。我们目前看到的画面同样令人惊叹，因此我只能认为，这款游戏会延续系列将PC硬件性能推向极限的传统。不过，游戏将在持续的内存危机期间推出，等性能测试结果陆续公布后，这或许会进一步限制其本就小众的吸引力。希望4A Games这次终于能让《地铁》在发售时具备良好的硬件适配性。
